test_title: PYST 21: SSC CGL 2023 - English (Held On: 21 Jul 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

A group of worshippers
solution: The correct answer is '**Congregation**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate word for the given group of words is '**Congregation**'. • **Congregation**: the act of coming together in a crowd or group; a gathering. (एकत्रित होने की क्रिया; सभा, जमाव) • *Example: the singing of psalms by the whole **congregation**...* **Correct Answer:__** *Congregation.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Crowd**: a large number of people in one place. (भीड़, जनसमूह) • **Caravan**: a large vehicle that is pulled by a car. You can sleep, cook, etc. in a caravan when you are travelling or on holiday. (कारयुक्त बड़ा वाहन जिसमें आमोद यात्रा के दौरान रहने, सोने, खाना पकाने आदि का प्रबंध होता है; कारवाँ) • **Constellation**: a group of stars that forms a pattern and has a name. (तारों का वह समूह जिससे कोई आकार बनता है तथा उसका कोई नाम होता है; तारामंडल, नक्षत्र) 30:T704, The correct answer is **'in a'.**
